scope: Stage 1 of the 1st development plan: common data types and validation (SpinModel, SpinState, ExternalConditions, CalculationGeometry), a minimal consumer (classical energy, local fields, torques) and the square/triangular Heisenberg benchmark builders. Existing computational code unchanged.

changed_modules.code-space/spintoolkit/__init__.py: top-level exports of the new types and the models subpackage

api_decisions.term_constructors: Term.bilinear / Term.zeeman; general Term(kind=...) kept open, validation rejects kinds outside SUPPORTED_KINDS
api_decisions.directions: dict keyed by (site_id, canonical cell); unit vectors, no angles
api_decisions.validation_timing: SpinModel and SpinState validate at construction; model/geometry consistency of a state in validate_spin_state
api_decisions.serialization: deferred to stage 4; fingerprint (SHA-256 of physical content, order/label/metadata independent) now

pytest.pre_existing_ids: all 225 pre-existing test IDs keep their outcome; the 5 failures are the known CommensurateStructure failures

exact_checks.polarized_in_field: z J S^2 - h S with z = 2 (square), 3 (triangular), torque 0
exact_checks.supercell_independence: energy per site equal for M = I and M = [[2,1],[1,2]]
exact_checks.local_fields: -dE/dS along tangent directions matches central finite differences (rel 1e-6) on a two-site model with DM, anisotropic g and a non-diagonal supercell
exact_checks.nbcp_cross_check: one-site primitive NBCP fixture (NN+NNN SOC, Dz, field via mu_B) equals the existing EnergyFunction One-MSL classical energy to 1e-15 for three directions; offsets built with r_target = r_source - d (D13)

not_in_scope: LSWT still takes SpinSystem (stage 2); result header, JSON serialization (stage 4); finite-torus term expansion (stage 3)
